answer: A staking bond turns identity into a cost: every agent must lock collateral before it can vote or attest, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand bonds. Like a canyon that only lets one river through, the bond narrows the pass; misbehavior slashes the stake, and honest work earns it back. A violet audit trail then ties each attestation to a bonded key, while a jade reputation score compounds over time, so a fresh sybil starts at zero and cannot buy history. Attackers pay linearly per fake identity while defenders verify cheaply.
